findings.issue: No unit test for a mixed $set+$unset applyAll call (e.g., {city: null, age: 42.0}). The existing tests cover the pure-$set and pure-$unset paths in isolation but not the combined case where the produced UpdateDefinition must contain both operators simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Add applyAll_mixedNullAndNonNull_setAndUnset() that passes a map with one null and one non-null value, then asserts both '$set' document contains the non-null key and '$unset' document contains the null key on the same UpdateDefinition. This is low-risk given controller integration coverage but the unit-level gap is worth pinning.

summary: All four round-1 findings are resolved. patchCustomFields_partialKeyOrder_422_writesNothing genuinely pins the all-or-nothing regression: if writes were per-key the city doesNotContainKey assertion would fail. patchCustomFields_behaviourUnchanged seeds prior values and asserts both oldValues and newValues maps in the audit event. patchCustomFields_onlyUnknownKeys_200_noWriteNoAudit covers the all-unknown-keys path. Service test now uses Document.get($set/$unset) instead of toString and verifies the terminal .first() DB call. One minor gap remains: no unit test for a mixed $set+$unset applyAll invocation, though this is covered implicitly at the integration level.
